versions.changelog:
Initial release of azure-ai-projects-py

- Provides high-level Python SDK (Foundry SDK) for building AI applications on Azure AI Foundry
- Supports agent creation (including versioned agents), tool integration, threads, runs, and agent memory stores
- Enables management of connections, model deployments, datasets, and indexes
- Includes evaluation features via OpenAI-compatible client
- Offers both synchronous and asynchronous client usage patterns
- Comprehensive usage documentation and best practices included in SKILL.md
